ideas.name: Days-to-Cover Decile Spread
ideas.claim: U.S. stocks in the highest days-to-cover decile underperformed those in the lowest decile over the following month.
ideas.quote: A strategy long low DTC decile stocks and short high DTC decile stocks yields 1.19% per month with a t-statistic of 6.67.

rules.entry: At month-end, rank stocks by days to cover; buy the lowest decile and short the highest decile.
rules.exit: Hold for the following month and reform the portfolio monthly.
rules.filters: Days to cover is the short-interest ratio divided by the month's average daily turnover ratio.

not_stated: transaction costs deducted from the reported portfolio return
ideas.claimed_result: Equal-weighted long-short return of 1.19% per month over January 1988 to December 2012.
